raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: quadrants
  version: "1.3.0"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/quadrants/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: fb96608c64dd62b4ac65c06e9963ad7feac29368f0ae468a386559cdbc124b36
    patches:
      # Remove once upstream guards AMDGPU runtime headers when QD_WITH_AMDGPU is disabled.
      - patches/0001-guard-disabled-amdgpu-includes.patch
      # Use conda-forge dependencies and shared LLVM instead of bundled/static copies.
      - patches/0002-use-system-dependencies.patch
      # Remove once upstream recognizes the CUDA 13 cuBLAS SONAME.
      - patches/0003-support-cublas-13.patch
  # Submodules without packages on every target platform are supplied as
  # separate immutable sources. The remaining submodules are conda packages.
  - url: https://github.com/Maratyszcza/FP16/archive/0a92994d729ff76a58f692d3028ca1b64b145d91.tar.gz
    sha256: a91f4770ff9c39f4d72e339c379f566b3bbb359fa66122d85fc0bae3dde7abc7
    target_directory: external/FP16
  - url: https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2/archive/1677374f23352716fc52183255a40c1b8e1d53eb.tar.gz
    sha256: 82f69e96c4ce2ba07eea2915d9300ad5d1a2303edb5a323c5a3a16bf18f484f4
    target_directory: external/PicoSHA2
  - url: https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/SPIRV-Cross/archive/2dcbe8d7d19ee78e2ab999ad62f8cf001a560c84.tar.gz
    sha256: 4e7e03b6b2016a0c4f05ce4cb53c101e140cfb24a604268d60b01dcf817d248f
    target_directory: external/SPIRV-Cross
  - url: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Reflect/archive/e55086b044225f9b511ae44dbf9b079d3625943f.tar.gz
    sha256: 038e08b1ecb62b316c1639d56d0c3dadb55ac03424998ac1a0c8afc788a09aeb
    target_directory: external/SPIRV-Reflect
  - url: https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator/archive/539c0a8d8e3733c9f25ea9a184c85c77504f1653.tar.gz
    sha256: 93cf11c14c6e602f73a87371c1ee0ae8c18c600a429171159c173b6185e4c99c
    target_directory: external/VulkanMemoryAllocator
  - url: https://github.com/taichi-dev/taichi_assets/archive/2905391325512f58adb3f8684bafc06ef29f8e47.tar.gz
    sha256: 836812059de1c758877d92d98047b080da34fa4f1783a6beafb617c35014c688
    target_directory: external/assets
  # Quadrants redistributes a reduced CUDA Toolkit libdevice bitcode file.
  - url: https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/redist/cuda_nvcc/LICENSE.txt
    sha256: e2c71babfd18a8e69542dd7e9ca018f9caa438094001a58e6bc4d8c999bf0d07
    file_name: LICENSE-NVIDIA
  # The Linux x86_64 build also redistributes ROCm device-library bitcode.
  - url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ROCm/llvm-project/rocm-7.0.0/amd/device-libs/LICENSE.TXT
    sha256: a4e8e3ba6e9255928a29d3085f929de402e61413cb0c49276e16b558effa8a2a
    file_name: LICENSE-ROCM-DEVICE-LIBS

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: quadrants
    build:
      # This is the Python range declared by upstream's pyproject.toml.
      skip:
        - match(python, ">=3.14")
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: bash "${RECIPE_DIR}/build.sh"
        - if: win
          then: call "%RECIPE_DIR%\\build.bat"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        # Quadrants uses build-platform Clang to emit embedded LLVM 22 bitcode.
        - clang >=22,<23
        # Match upstream's cmake_minimum_required declaration.
        - cmake >=3.17
        - ninja
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        # Match upstream's pyproject.toml build-system requirements.
        - setuptools_scm >=6.0
        - numpy >=2.0.0
        # This upper bound is declared by upstream's pyproject.toml.
        - nanobind >=2.0.0,<2.14.0
        - scikit-build-core >=0.10
        # Upstream generates nanobind stubs at install time, which imports quadrants.
        - colorama
        - dill
        - pydantic >=2.0.0
        - rich >=1.0.0
        - setuptools >=77.0.0
        - cffi >=1.16.0
        # Quadrants embeds LLVM 22 bitcode and links against the matching runtime.
        - llvmdev >=22,<23
        # Static LLVM targets on Windows reference these support libraries.
        - if: win
          then:
            - libxml2-devel
            - zlib
            - zstd
        - spdlog
        - fmt
        - eigen
        - dlpack
        - spirv-headers
        - spirv-tools
        - if: not osx
          then:
            - libvulkan-headers
            - vulkan-volk
      run:
        - python
        # Match upstream's project dependencies.
        - numpy >=1.26.0
        - colorama
        - dill
        - pydantic >=2.0.0
        - rich >=1.0.0
        - setuptools >=77.0.0
        - cffi >=1.16.0
        - if: unix
          then: libllvm22 >=22,<23
        - if: not osx
          then: libvulkan-loader
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - quadrants
            - quadrants._lib.core.quadrants_python
      - script:
          - pip check
          - python run_test.py
          - if: unix
            then: QD_WANTED_ARCHS=cpu python -m pytest -q tests/python/test_smoke.py tests/python/test_basics.py::test_range_loops
          - if: win
            then: set QD_WANTED_ARCHS=cpu&& python -m pytest -q tests/python/test_smoke.py tests/python/test_basics.py::test_range_loops
        files:
          source:
            - tests/__init__.py
            - tests/test_utils.py
            - tests/python/__init__.py
            - tests/python/conftest.py
            - tests/python/test_smoke.py
            - tests/python/test_basics.py
          recipe:
            - run_test.py
        requirements:
          run:
            - pip
            - pytest
            - pytest-xdist >=3.7
            - python

  - package:
      name: quadrants-cuda
    build:
      noarch: generic
      # Build the platform-independent convenience package only once.
      skip:
        - not linux or not x86_64
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("quadrants", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
        - libcublas
        - libcusolver
        - libcusparse
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - quadrants

  - package:
      name: quadrants-rocm
    build:
      noarch: generic
      # Build the platform-independent convenience package only once.
      skip:
        - not linux or not x86_64
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("quadrants", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
        # This upstream minimum also limits installation to Linux x86_64 today.
        - hip-runtime-amd >=5.2
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - quadrants

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/quadrants
  summary: Python-embedded domain-specific language for accelerated simulation kernels
  license: Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND NCSA AND LicenseRef-NVIDIA-End-User-License-Agreement
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LICENSE-NVIDIA
    - LICENSE-ROCM-DEVICE-LIBS
    - LICENSE-vendored-components
    - external/FP16/LICENSE
    - external/PicoSHA2/LICENSE
    - external/SPIRV-Cross/LICENSE
    - external/SPIRV-Reflect/LICENSE
    - external/VulkanMemoryAllocator/LICENSE.txt
  repository: https://github.com/Genesis-Embodied-AI/quadrants

  feedstock-name: quadrants
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
